baseline.tests: PASS: deterministic cognitive lesion/rescue falsification suite

integration_design: Require paired RESCUE disabled_capability_ids to equal the paired LESION disabled_capability_ids; retain rescued_capability_ids as a non-empty subset so partial restoration remains representable.
Seal explicit score metric and lesion/rescue operator identities into the comparison experiment digest, using typed constants or fields rather than prose-only versioning.
Add reset/order-independence repository falsifiers using fresh begin_episode boundaries and require exact per-condition equality across at least two execution permutations.

Add conservative typed interpretation semantics: TESTED_INTERVENTION_DEPENDENCE, TARGET_SPECIFIC_RESTORATION_AT_SCOPE, REDUNDANCY_OR_INTERACTION_UNKNOWN, NO_RESTORATION_AT_SCOPE. Never emit necessity/sufficiency/unique-cause/global-cognition claims.

Reuse the existing Trigger-4 SHAM/no-target-restore and unrelated-rescue review as negative-control requirements; do not duplicate research credit or add new condition kinds unless implementation needs them.
reproducible_acceptance_tests: mismatched paired lesion/rescue disabled sets fail closed before evaluator stepping
metric/operator identity mutation changes sealed comparison identity
fixed-identity per-condition outputs are invariant to execution order from fresh episode boundaries
zero isolated lesion effect maps to REDUNDANCY_OR_INTERACTION_UNKNOWN rather than IRRELEVANT
target-specific restoration is impossible when paired target identity is mismatched
all existing generation-1 hidden-state/subtype/generation/provenance/abstention tests remain green
no evaluator-private field is admitted into choose_action_public input
counterhypotheses: Explicit metric/operator fields may be redundant because exact source blob identity already binds semantics; reject new fields if Trigger-4 proves an equally strong source-hash-bound experiment identity with less schema cost.

Order-permutation tests may be redundant because all condition state is local and begin_episode always resets; retain the test only if it protects against a realistic future cache/global-state regression at negligible cost.
Typed interpretation labels may add downstream coupling without improving decisions; reject them if equivalent bounded semantics are already mechanically enforced by a consumer.

efficiency_requirements.model_calls: MUST_NOT_INCREASE; generation-2 hardening should remain deterministic and model-free
efficiency_requirements.latency: RECORD repository-test wall-time if available; reject material regression unexplained by test-count increase
efficiency_requirements.cpu_memory_io: No new external service, database, model, network or heavyweight dependency; ordinary Python data/validation only

measurement_plan.quality: Record exact pass/fail for old and new falsifiers plus deterministic comparison digests.
measurement_plan.tokens: Verify source/test path contains no model/provider invocation; runtime token metric is NOT_APPLICABLE unless Trigger-4 introduces one, which should reject this candidate.
measurement_plan.latency_resources: If CI exposes timing/resource telemetry, record it; otherwise explicitly preserve UNKNOWN rather than inventing values.
measurement_plan.higher_level: Do not run target VPS/model/GRID/GWT/J-Space from this inbox unless separately authorized and claimed by Trigger-4.

expected_benefit: Higher causal-control falsification strength and safer downstream interpretation without expanding the benchmark's authority or adding model/runtime cost.
